How Indore Property Finder collects data

Our rules

  • We check each source's robots.txt, terms of service and technical access controls before collecting anything.
  • We never bypass CAPTCHAs, logins, paywalls or anti-bot systems.
  • Where automated collection is not permitted, the connector stays disabled and is marked honestly below.
  • We prefer official APIs, licensed feeds, partner integrations and explicitly authorized scraping.
  • Administrators can import datasets from providers who hold the rights (CSV/JSON), with full validation.
  • We never fabricate listings, prices, URLs or coordinates. Missing data is shown as “not available”.
  • Personal contact details are not collected or republished.
  • Listings that a source asks us to remove are taken down promptly (see takedown section).

Coordinates & map honesty

Latitude/longitude values come only from source-provided data or an authorized geocoding provider (e.g. Nominatim/Google). Each point stores its precision: exact (green marker) or approximate locality area (amber marker). Approximate points are never presented as exact property locations, and listings without verified coordinates are omitted from the map entirely.

Duplicates & price statistics

The same home may appear on several portals. Our engine flags likely duplicates using listing IDs, URLs, titles, geometry and price signals, but uncertain matches are never silently merged — every source record keeps its own price, area and original URL.

Locality price figures are asking prices from collected listings, not registered transaction values or government guidance prices. Small samples are withheld rather than published as misleading averages.

Takedown requests

Are you a portal, builder, agent or homeowner and want a listing removed or corrected? Email legal@localhost with the listing URL(s). We verify and remove within 7 days; removals are recorded in our audit trail.

Scope: this release covers Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India only. Listings from other cities are rejected at ingestion even if similarly named. See also data retention policy.
